title: 控制措施层级：从塔尖往下建
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/08_Module 5 — Hierarchy of Controls.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/08_Module 5 — Hierarchy of Controls/src.py

points.K3: 只靠防护，等于赌人不出错
points.K7: 消除：危害不在就伤不了人
points.K13: 管理措施靠监督和自觉

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一座倒置的五层金字塔模型旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an upside-down five-layer pyramid model and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲控制措施层级。
overlay: 控制措施层级：从塔尖往下建

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层依次亮起，从宽到窄
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid icon with five layers lighting up one by one from the wide top to the narrow tip. No people.
shots.narration: 消除、替代、工程、管理、防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰从柜子里抱出一大盒手套，准备做一个新实验
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls a big box of disposable gloves out of a cabinet, ready to start a new experiment.
shots.narration: 阿杰要做新实验，先抱出一盒手套。

shots.scene: 阿杰对老周比划：戴上手套就行
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gestures confidently to the older man while holding up his gloved hands.
shots.narration: 他说：戴上手套就安全了。

shots.scene: 老周摇头，指向墙上的倒金字塔图
shots.prompt_en: The older man shakes his head and points at a blank inverted pyramid chart on the wall.
shots.narration: 老周摇头：你从最底下开始了。

shots.scene: 欣欣在倒金字塔前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the inverted pyramid chart and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先问能不能不用它，再问怎么挡住它。

shots.scene: 护目镜和一大盒手套图标，旁边一个向下的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles and a large glove box with a downward arrow pointing to the bottom of a pyramid. No people.
shots.narration: 一想到安全就想到护目镜和手套，

shots.scene: 箭头翻转，指向金字塔顶部
shots.prompt_en: The arrow flips and points to the wide top of the inverted pyramid. No people.
shots.narration: 其实是从最末端开始了。

shots.scene: 一张菜单被红叉划掉，旁边是编号1到5的阶梯
shots.prompt_en: A restaurant-style menu card crossed out with a red X beside a staircase numbered one to five. No people.
shots.narration: 控制措施不是菜单，不能随便挑。

shots.scene: 从1到5的箭头依次下行
shots.prompt_en: Arrows step down from level one to level five in strict order. No people.
shots.narration: 它是严格的先后顺序。

shots.scene: “戴上手套就行”的对话气泡，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A speech bubble with a single glove icon inside, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: “戴上手套就行”，是最危险的一句话。

shots.section_title: 只靠防护，等于赌人不出错
shots.scene: 一只手套挡在危害前，旁边骰子图标
shots.prompt_en: A single glove icon standing alone in front of a hazard symbol, with a pair of dice beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 只靠个人防护，
overlay: 只靠防护，等于赌人不出错

shots.section_title: 只靠防护，等于赌人不出错
shots.scene: 人形图标打哈欠、着急、分心三个状态
shots.prompt_en: Three person pictograms: one yawning, one rushing with a clock, one distracted by a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 就是赌人一次都不出错。

shots.section_title: 只靠防护，等于赌人不出错
shots.scene: 骰子滚出一个红叉
shots.prompt_en: The dice roll and land showing a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 时间一长，这个赌一定会输。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔，顶部最宽一层标着垃圾桶图标
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid with the widest top layer marked by a trash bin icon removing a hazard symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 倒金字塔：最宽的顶层是消除危害。

shots.scene: 金字塔各层依次往下变窄，最底尖端是手套
shots.prompt_en: The pyramid layers narrow step by step down to a tiny tip marked with a glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 越往下越窄，最底下才是个人防护。

shots.scene: 顶层的大伞罩住多数危害图标
shots.prompt_en: A large umbrella over the top layer covering most of the hazard symbols underneath. No people.
shots.narration: 大部分风险，应该在上层解决。

shots.scene: 正立金字塔：底部堆满手套盒，顶部空空
shots.prompt_en: An upright pyramid with its wide base piled with glove boxes and an empty tiny top. No people.
shots.narration: 很多实验室正好做反了：

shots.scene: 成箱的手套运进来，通风橱旁贴着待修标签
shots.prompt_en: Crates of gloves being delivered while a fume hood nearby has a blank repair tag hanging on it. No people.
shots.narration: 大批发手套，却舍不得投入上层措施。

shots.scene: 左边盾牌图标打勾，右边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two cards side by side: a shield icon with a green check on the left, a yellow warning triangle on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 各层最大的差别，是可靠性。

shots.scene: 盾牌罩着一个打瞌睡的人形，依然安全
shots.prompt_en: A shield dome covers a dozing person pictogram, and the hazard outside cannot reach it. No people.
shots.narration: 层级越高，人犯了错也不怕。

shots.scene: 手套出现小破口，人形图标旁有时钟和手机
shots.prompt_en: A glove with a small tear next to a rushing person pictogram with a clock and a phone. No people.
shots.narration: 层级越低，一累一急一分心就失效。

shots.section_title: 消除：危害不在就伤不了人
shots.scene: 老周和小研对着空白方法流程图讨论，把一个瓶子图标拿掉
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student discuss a blank method flowchart and remove a bottle icon from it.
shots.narration: 最有力的是消除：直接去掉危害。
overlay: 消除：危害不在就伤不了人

shots.section_title: 消除：危害不在就伤不了人
shots.scene: 一个带骷髅警示的试剂瓶被扔进回收箱，流程线照样连通
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a health hazard pictogram is removed into a disposal crate while the process line stays connected. No people.
shots.narration: 某药企改了方法，去掉了4-溴苯胺。

shots.section_title: 消除：危害不在就伤不了人
shots.scene: 日历翻过半年，长长的时间轴在一点被截断
shots.prompt_en: A calendar flips through several months, then a long timeline bar is cut off at one point. No people.
shots.narration: 验证花了半年，一夜结束25年暴露。

shots.section_title: 消除：危害不在就伤不了人
shots.scene: 空空的位置，危害图标消失，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An empty spot where a hazard symbol used to be, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 危害不在了，就不可能伤人。

shots.scene: 危险溶剂瓶换成带绿叶图标的溶剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: A solvent bottle with a flame pictogram is swapped for a bottle marked with a green leaf icon. No people.
shots.narration: 去不掉，就换成更安全的。

shots.scene: 废物桶图标缩小，旁边柱状图下降
shots.prompt_en: A waste drum icon shrinking next to a bar chart going down. No people.
shots.narration: 某合成路线换溶剂，废物减少约70%。

shots.scene: 安全和环保两个图标握手
shots.prompt_en: A safety shield icon and a green leaf icon shaking hands. No people.
shots.narration: 安全和绿色，可以一起实现。

shots.scene: 小研对着六格空白流程图逐格讲解
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at a blank six-step flowchart on a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 替代不是随手一换，要按步骤来。

shots.scene: 两只瓶子放在天平两端比较
shots.prompt_en: Two blank bottles placed on either side of a balance scale for comparison. No people.
shots.narration: 比一比毒性和危险性，看成本和可行性。

shots.scene: 老周在空白审批单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank change approval form.
shots.narration: 小试验证后，按变更审批再推广。

shots.scene: 新瓶子下藏着一个新的问号危害，被放大镜照出
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass reveals a hidden question-mark hazard under a new replacement bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 别用一个已知危害，换来一个新危害。

shots.scene: 通风橱把蒸气从橱内抽走的示意
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood icon with arrows showing vapors being drawn inward and up the exhaust duct. No people.
shots.narration: 去不掉、换不了，就把它隔离起来。

shots.scene: 通风橱前站着一个心不在焉的人形，蒸气仍被抽走
shots.prompt_en: A distracted person pictogram stands at a fume hood while vapor arrows are still captured inside. No people.
shots.narration: 工程控制靠设备，不靠人记不记得规矩。

shots.scene: 风速表指针在绿区
shots.prompt_en: An airflow gauge on a fume hood with the needle in the green zone. No people.
shots.narration: 面风速每分钟80到120英尺时，源头抽走。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜和手套箱图标并列
shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon and a glove box icon side by side, each with a lock symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜、手套箱，也是同样道理。

shots.scene: 一排通风橱、安全柜整齐排列
shots.prompt_en: A row of fume hoods and safety cabinets lined up in a lab, sturdy and well maintained. No people.
shots.narration: 它们耐用、可靠，是实验室的主力。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白白板前列出五项
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at a blank whiteboard with five blank items listed.
shots.narration: 管理措施，管的是流程和行为。

shots.scene: 老周审阅空白申请表，旁边是放大的烧瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: The older man reviews a blank application form beside an icon of an enlarged flask with an up arrow.
shots.narration: 扩大反应规模，要先审批。

shots.scene: 时钟图标显示白天，楼里有值班人员
shots.prompt_en: A clock showing daytime next to a building icon with staff on duty and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 高风险操作，安排在有人支援的时段。

shots.scene: 小研举手叫停，阿杰停下；两人结伴操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises her hand to stop work; then she and the young male student work side by side.
shots.narration: 人人可以叫停，危险实验结伴做。

shots.section_title: 管理措施靠监督和自觉
shots.scene: 管理措施靠检查和自觉，人形旁有眼睛图标和对勾
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram with an eye icon for supervision and a check mark for compliance. No people.
shots.narration: 管理措施好不好，全看监督和遵守。
overlay: 管理措施靠监督和自觉

shots.section_title: 管理措施靠监督和自觉
shots.scene: 打哈欠的人形拿着咖啡杯
shots.prompt_en: A yawning person pictogram holding a coffee cup in the early morning. No people.
shots.narration: 人不是机器，早上也会犯迷糊。

shots.section_title: 管理措施靠监督和自觉
shots.scene: 自燃标识旁，小研专注地操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with full concentration beside a flame-over-circle hazard pictogram.
shots.narration: 高危操作，这一层必须时刻警惕。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔最底尖端亮起，标着手套
shots.prompt_en: The narrow tip of the inverted pyramid lights up with a glove icon. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护，是最后一道防线。

shots.scene: 门口给每个人发一副同样的手套，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of handing the same pair of gloves to everyone at the door, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 人手一副丁腈手套，远远不够。

shots.scene: 三种手套对着酮类、烃类两种瓶子，打勾或打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three glove icons facing two blank bottles, with green checks and red crosses in a simple grid. No people.
shots.narration: 不同手套，耐的化学品不一样。

shots.scene: 乳胶手套挡住微生物图标，却被化学液滴穿过
shots.prompt_en: A latex glove icon blocks microbe icons but chemical droplets pass through it. No people.
shots.narration: 乳胶挡得住微生物，挡不住多数化学品。

shots.scene: 小研查空白兼容性表，挑出一副手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank compatibility chart and picks a matching pair of gloves.
shots.narration: 按具体化学品挑手套，没有万能款。

shots.scene: 通风橱前一个戴丁腈手套的人形，日历翻过六周
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram in nitrile gloves working at a fume hood while a calendar flips through six weeks. No people.
shots.narration: 一名研究生在通风橱里，天天戴丁腈，

shots.scene: 人形旁一个“无感觉”的平静表情
shots.prompt_en: A calm face icon with no pain symbol next to the person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 处理新型含氟中间体，六周毫无感觉。

shots.scene: 液滴悄悄穿过手套剖面，渗到皮肤
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section showing droplets silently passing through a glove into the skin, with a small timer. No people.
shots.narration: 其实试剂不到30分钟就渗透了。

shots.scene: 体检单图标上一个指标箭头上升
shots.prompt_en: A blank medical checkup report icon with one indicator arrow going up in red. No people.
shots.narration: 直到例行体检，才发现肝酶升高。

shots.scene: 内层专用手套加外层丁腈的剖面，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of an inner specialty glove under an outer nitrile glove, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 内层加一副专用手套，本可避免。

shots.scene: 空白评估表上一个红圈
shots.prompt_en: A blank hazard assessment form with a red circle on a missing line. No people.
shots.narration: 问题出在：一开始没评估透。

shots.scene: 四片带孔的奶酪片排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Four slices of cheese with holes lined up in a row, a hazard arrow approaching. No people.
shots.narration: 每层防护都有漏洞。

shots.scene: 四片分别标替代、手套箱、结伴、阻燃服，箭头被某一片挡住
shots.prompt_en: The four slices are marked with icons of a safer bottle, a glove box, two people, and a flame-resistant coat; the hazard arrow passes one hole but is stopped by the next slice. No people.
shots.narration: 一层失手，下一层还能接住。

shots.scene: 欣欣把几层透明板叠在一起
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stacks several transparent shield panels together.
shots.narration: 一起高校致死事故，说明这很必要。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着倒金字塔顶部，问号浮现
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the top of the inverted pyramid with a question mark floating beside it.
shots.narration: 主要措施失效时，有没有上层兜底？

shots.scene: 只剩一只手套挡着危害，被一个小失误突破
shots.prompt_en: A single glove icon as the only barrier is breached by a small slip icon. No people.
shots.narration: 别让一个小失误，击穿唯一的防线。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在倒金字塔旁，从上往下指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the inverted pyramid and points from the top down.
shots.narration: 先消除，再替代，

shots.scene: 通风橱、手套箱和规程本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood, a glove box and a blank procedure book. No people.
shots.narration: 工程隔离，管理到位，

shots.scene: 匹配的手套和阻燃服图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of matched chemical gloves and a flame-resistant coat. No people.
shots.narration: 最后才是匹配的个人防护。

shots.scene: 几片奶酪叠成一道墙
shots.prompt_en: Several cheese slices stacked together forming a solid wall that blocks a hazard arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 多层防护，一层失手还有下一层。

shots.scene: 欣欣在倒金字塔前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the inverted pyramid.
shots.narration: 安全从塔尖建起，下次见！
